answer: Stake-weighted reputation bonding: each new agent identity must lock a bond (saffron tier = small) that unlocks only after its graded work keeps a steady pulse of approvals over weeks. Jurors are drawn randomly from older, ivory-tier identities. An attacker running 1,000 fake identities must lock 1,000 bonds and sustain original, high-quality work from each for weeks; any plagiarism or collusion detected slashes every linked bond, so Sybils cost real capital and labor.
